easy.def: Something you are very good at.
easy.example: She has a talent for singing.

more.def: A natural ability to do something well.
more.example: His talent for drawing was clear even when he was little.
Grandpa makes a tasty vegetable stew.

easy.def: A tool that makes far away things look big.
easy.example: I saw the moon with a telescope.

more.def: A tool you look through that makes distant things, like stars, appear larger and closer.
more.example: Through the telescope, we could see the rings of Saturn.

easy.def: How hot or cold something is.

more.def: A measure of how hot or cold something is.
more.example: The temperature dropped below freezing, and the pond turned to ice.
A terrible storm knocked out the power for two days.

easy.def: The loud boom you hear in a storm.

more.def: The loud rumbling sound that follows a flash of lightning.
more.example: The thunder rattled the windows of the house.

more.def: Neat, with everything in its proper place.
more.example: He keeps his desk tidy so he can find things easily.
A tiny seed can grow into a giant tree.

easy.def: A storm with wind that spins very fast.
easy.example: The tornado spun across the field.

more.def: A powerful storm with a spinning, funnel-shaped column of wind.
more.example: The family hid in the basement until the tornado passed.

easy.def: Something a family or group does again and again over many years.
easy.example: It is our tradition to bake a cake on birthdays.

more.def: A belief or way of doing things that is passed down in a family or group over time.
more.example: It is a tradition in her family to tell stories around the fire every winter.

easy.def: Clear, so you can see through it.

more.def: Clear enough that you can see through it.
more.example: The jellyfish was almost transparent in the water.

easy.def: To go from one place to another.
easy.example: We travel to the beach by car.

more.def: To go from one place to another, often over a long distance.
more.example: They traveled across the country by train.

easy.def: Gold, gems, or other special things.

more.def: Valuable things such as gold and jewels, or something very special to you.
more.example: The divers found treasure in the sunken ship.

easy.example: My hands tremble when I am cold.

more.def: To shake slightly because you are cold, afraid, or excited.
more.example: The leaves trembled in the gentle wind.

easy.def: To feel sure that someone is good and honest.

more.def: To believe that someone is honest and will not hurt you or let you down.
more.example: You can trust her to keep a promise.
